professionalSummary.text: Gathered and documented requirements from sales leadership for CRM changes through requirement workshops with regional sales directors, resulting in user stories with acceptance criteria agreed upon before build.
professionalSummary.witness: ran requirement workshops with the regional sales directors and turned the outcomes into user stories for discount-approval changes, each with acceptance criteria agreed with the directors before build.

professionalSummary.text: Configured a three-tier discount approval workflow in the quoting tool, routing quotes above 15% discount to regional directors and above 30% to finance director's office.
professionalSummary.witness: Configured a three-tier discount approval workflow in the quoting tool, sending quotes above 15% discount to the regional director and those above 30% to the finance director's office.

professionalSummary.text: Moved a discount approval workflow into the live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, after testing in a full-copy sandbox, and monitored approval times for six weeks post-release.
professionalSummary.witness: Moved the discount approval workflow into the live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, after testing in the full-copy sandbox, and monitored quote approval times for six weeks after release.

professionalSummary.text: Maintained the opportunity-field data dictionary by recording field owners, picklist values, and reporting usage for 140 fields, and circulated monthly changes to the reporting team.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the opportunity-field data dictionary current, recording the owner, picklist values and reporting use of each of 140 fields, and circulated the monthly changes to the reporting team.

professionalSummary.text: Built a dashboard for the sales operations manager showing regional share of quotes passing through new approval steps, refreshed daily from CRM report data.
professionalSummary.witness: Built a dashboard for the sales operations manager showing, by region, the share of quotes that passed through the new approval steps; the dashboard refreshed daily from CRM report data.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted requirement workshops with regional sales directors to document discount-approval changes, with acceptance criteria agreed before build.
experienceHighlights.witness: ran requirement workshops with the regional sales directors and turned the outcomes into user stories for discount-approval changes, each with acceptance criteria agreed with the directors before build.

experienceHighlights.text: Configured a three-tier discount approval workflow in the quoting tool, routing quotes above 15% discount to regional directors and above 30% to finance director's office.
experienceHighlights.witness: Configured a three-tier discount approval workflow in the quoting tool, sending quotes above 15% discount to the regional director and those above 30% to the finance director's office.

experienceHighlights.text: Deployed a discount approval workflow to live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, following sandbox testing, and monitored approval times for six weeks post-release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Moved the discount approval workflow into the live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, after testing in the full-copy sandbox, and monitored quote approval times for six weeks after release.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained the opportunity-field data dictionary for 140 fields, recording owners, picklist values, and usage reporting, with monthly updates circulated to the reporting team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the opportunity-field data dictionary current, recording the owner, picklist values and reporting use of each of 140 fields, and circulated the monthly changes to the reporting team.

experienceHighlights.text: Developed a daily-refreshing dashboard for sales operations manager showing regional quote approval step usage, sourced from CRM report data.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built a dashboard for the sales operations manager showing, by region, the share of quotes that passed through the new approval steps; the dashboard refreshed daily from CRM report data.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Post-implementation review for CR-2207 included change-board approval date (6 March 2024), release date (11 March 2024), sandbox test results, and six-week approval-time figures post-release, signed off by sales operations manager; appendix listed two minor defects and fixes.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the post-implementation review for CR-2207, with the change-board approval date (6 March 2024), the release date (11 March 2024), the sandbox tests passed beforehand and the approval-time figures for the six weeks after release, signed off by the sales operations manager; an appendix lists two minor defects found after release and their fixes.

skills.witness: Moved the discount approval workflow into the live CRM on 11 March 2024 under change request CR-2207, after testing in the full-copy sandbox, and monitored quote approval times for six weeks after release.
Kept the opportunity-field data dictionary current, recording the owner, picklist values and reporting use of each of 140 fields, and circulated the monthly changes to the reporting team.
Built a dashboard for the sales operations manager showing, by region, the share of quotes that passed through the new approval steps; the dashboard refreshed daily from CRM report data.
